headline: Perplexity launches AI 'Teammates' agents for work
summary: Perplexity has launched 'Teammates,' always-on AI agents that can take on multiple workplace roles, pulling in a user's existing projects, skills and memory, and integrating with Perplexity Computer to deploy agents directly on a device.

claims.statement: Perplexity launched "Teammates," AI agents designed for workplace tasks.

sources.quote: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
Perplexity's 'teammates' are the company's AI agents for daily work tasks

claims.statement: Teammates are always-on and can take on multiple roles within a workspace.

sources.quote: always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace

claims.statement: Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, which can deploy agents on a user's device.

sources.quote: Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, an AI system that can deploy agents on your device
